patch_description: This replaces the fixed concentric-ring layout with a hybrid geometric optimization method. It begins from a near-hexagonal six-row arrangement, then uses several perturbed starts in a nonlinear constrained optimizer to move centers and independently vary all radii. For every candidate set of centers, a linear program recomputes the globally best feasible radii for those centers. This alternating nonlinear-position / linear-radius strategy handles boundary circles, unequal radii, and asymmetric local improvements substantially better than proportionally shrinking overlapping circles.
